def exchange(lst1, lst2):
    # Check if lst1 is already all even or all odd
    if all(num % 2 == 0 for num in lst1) or all(num % 2 != 0 for num in lst1):
        return "YES"
    
    # Count the number of even numbers in lst2
    even_count = sum(1 for num in lst2 if num % 2 == 0)
    
    # If lst1 is already all even, return 'YES'
    if even_count == len(lst2):
        return "YES"
    
    # If lst2 has enough even numbers to exchange with lst1, return 'YES'
    if even_count >= len(lst1):
        return "YES"
    
    # Determine if it is possible to exchange elements between lst1 and lst2 to make lst1 all even
    total_even = even_count + sum(1 for num in lst1 if num % 2 == 0)
    if total_even >= len(lst1):
        return "YES"
    
    return "NO"
